summary: Final sweep for ANY remaining missing religion-wedges or corpora — reference-driven, exhaustive

result.summary: Seven regional goblins surfaced ~40 candidate gaps; after Tier-1-source filtering and vault-doc cross-check, three categories emerge. HIGH PRIORITY (ship now): three structural fixes where vault docs already exist but are mis-routed — Manichaeism wedge wrongly points to cathar-bogomil corpus, Cathar/Bogomil needs its own wedge (4 vault docs orphaned), and Lucumí/Santería corpus needs to split off from afro-diasporic-liturgical bundle. MEDIUM PRIORITY (Lane A queue): 12 Tier-1-backed gaps that need new docs — Latin American syncretic traditions (Candomblé, Umbanda, Guadalupan/Nican Mopohua, Santa Muerte, Palo Mayombe, Kardecist Spiritism), three Hindu sub-canon splits (Gaudiya, Madhva, Ram-bhakti, SRF/Yogananda), two NRMs (Falun Gong, Sōka Gakkai), three African Initiated Church canons (Shembe, Kimbangu, Akan/Christaller), three ancient extinct (Etruscan, Phoenician/Punic, Mithraism corpus-split), and two Western esoteric (Golden Dawn, Gurdjieff/Fourth Way). LOW/SKIP: 15 items including thin single-doc sub-traditions (Mirabai-only Rajasthani Krishna-bhakti), oral-substrate ethnographies without indigenous scripture (BaKongo, Igbo), and small esoteric branches with thin vault relevance (Society of Inner Light, Martinism, OTO-as-split). After applying high-priority fixes the 55-wedge / 100-corpus taxonomy is structurally sound but Latin American syncretism and African Initiated Churches remain the two largest unfilled gaps requiring Lane A content batches.

high_priority_adds.label: FIX: re-route manichaeism wedge from cathar-bogomil to mandaean-manichaean corpus
high_priority_adds.tier1_source: BeDuhn 2000 The Manichaean Body (Johns Hopkins UP); Lieu 1992 Manichaeism in the Later Roman Empire and Medieval China (Mohr Siebeck); Gardner & Lieu 2004 Manichaean Texts from the Roman Empire (Cambridge UP)

high_priority_adds.label: Cathar / Bogomil dualist Christianity (new standalone wedge)
high_priority_adds.tier1_source: Hamilton 1998 Christian Dualist Heresies in the Byzantine World c.650-c.1450 (Manchester UP, Manchester Medieval Sources Series); Lambert 2002 Medieval Heresy: Popular Movements from the Gregorian Reform to the Reformation (Blackwell)

high_priority_adds.label: Split Lucumí/Santería out of afro-diasporic-liturgical into own corpus under lucumi-santeria wedge
high_priority_adds.tier1_source: Brandon 1993 Santeria from Africa to the New World (Indiana UP); Brown 2003 Santería Enthroned (Chicago UP); Murphy 1988 Santería: African Spirits in America (Beacon); Cabrera 1954 El Monte (Ediciones C.R., Havana)

medium_priority_adds.label: Gaudiya Vaishnava canon (Chaitanya/Six Goswamis)
medium_priority_adds.reason: Vault has phase-6-020-chaitanya-charitamrita with explicit Gaudiya sub-tradition tag; Bryant & Ekstrand 2004 + Flood 1996 treat as distinct sampradaya. Split into own corpus row within Hinduism wedge.

medium_priority_adds.label: Madhva / Dvaita Vedanta canon
medium_priority_adds.reason: Vault has phase-5-022-madhva-brahma-sutra-bhasya with explicit Dvaita tag; Sharma 1962 Motilal Banarsidass treats as distinct theistic-dualist sampradaya. Split into own corpus row.

medium_priority_adds.label: Hindi Ram-bhakti canon (Tulsidas/Ramanand)
medium_priority_adds.reason: Vault has phase-6-019-tulsidas-ramcharitmanas + phase-6-030-vinaya-patrika both tagged Ram-bhakti Hindi; Lutgendorf 1991 UC Press treats as distinct from Sanskritic Vedanta. Two-doc corpus ready.

medium_priority_adds.label: SRF / Kriya Yoga (Yogananda lineage)
medium_priority_adds.reason: Vault has phase-7-026-autobiography-of-a-yogi; Melton Encyclopedia of American Religions + Urban 2015 UC Press treat SRF as distinct NRM lineage. Currently mis-bundled with Aurobindo + Hindutva in hindu-modernism-corpus.

medium_priority_adds.label: Candomblé (Ketu/Jeje/Angola)
medium_priority_adds.reason: tradition-candomble.md already exists with Tier-1 refs (Harding 2000 Indiana UP, Verger 1957, Bastide 1958); Lane A content batch needed for canonical doc nodes (Verger orixá-saint syncretism, Carneiro corpus).

medium_priority_adds.label: Umbanda (Brazilian Afro-Catholic-Spiritist)
medium_priority_adds.reason: Brown 1986 Columbia UP + Ortiz 1978 + Matta e Silva 1956 primary; pontos-riscados symbol node already exists. Distinct from Candomblé per Brown 1986 (post-1908 Zélio de Moraes synthesis). Lane A batch required.

medium_priority_adds.label: Mexican Folk Catholicism / Guadalupan-Nahua syncretism
medium_priority_adds.reason: Brading 2001 Cambridge UP + Lafaye 1976 Chicago; Nican Mopohua (1649) is canonical textual artifact. MASSIVE-WINS node (Tonantzin → Guadalupe) currently invisible. Lane A batch required.

medium_priority_adds.label: Santa Muerte cult (Mexican folk-Catholic 1965+)
medium_priority_adds.reason: Chesnut 2012 Oxford UP + Lomnitz 2005 Zone; Romo's Ritual Libro Santo (1998) + seven-color veladora doctrine codified. ~10-12M adherents. Lane A batch required.

medium_priority_adds.label: Palo Mayombe / Palo Monte (Cuban Bantu-Kongo)
medium_priority_adds.reason: Cabrera 1954 + Ochoa 2010 California + Palmié 2002 Duke; structurally distinct from Yoruba-Santería (BaKongo not Yoruba). Lane A batch required.

medium_priority_adds.label: Kardecist Spiritism (Allan Kardec pentateuch)
medium_priority_adds.reason: Hess 1991 Penn State + Sharp 2006 Lexington; the 'Spiritist Pentateuch' (1857-1868) is codified canonical corpus. Brazil has largest global Spiritist population. tradition-spiritualism.md mentions Kardec but no doc nodes. Lane A batch required.

medium_priority_adds.label: Etruscan religion (Etrusca Disciplina)
medium_priority_adds.reason: De Grummond 2006 UPenn + De Grummond & Simon 2006 UTexas + Turfa 2012 Cambridge UP; Liber Linteus Zagrabiensis + Pyrgi Tablets + Piacenza Liver are canonical primary sources. Zero vault coverage today. Lane A batch required.

medium_priority_adds.label: Phoenician / Punic religion
medium_priority_adds.reason: Lipinski 1995 Peeters Studia Phoenicia XIV + Quinn 2018 Princeton UP; Sanchuniathon fragments + Marseille Tariff + Eshmunazar inscription. Lipinski explicitly distinguishes from Canaanite-Ugaritic (already covered). Lane A batch required.

medium_priority_adds.label: Roman Mithraism (corpus split from mystery-cults)
medium_priority_adds.reason: Beck 2006 Oxford UP + Clauss 2000 Edinburgh + Vermaseren CIMRM 1956-60; partial vault coverage via PGM IV Mithras Liturgy embed. Beck argues distinct cult with own initiation grades + tauroctony canon. Lane A batch for dedicated nodes.

medium_priority_adds.label: Falun Gong / Falun Dafa
medium_priority_adds.reason: Ownby 2008 Oxford UP + Penny 2012 Chicago UP; Zhuan Falun (1995) treated as canonical scripture. Lane A batch required.

medium_priority_adds.label: Sōka Gakkai / Nichiren Shōshū (Ikeda + Gosho)
medium_priority_adds.reason: Métraux 1994 UP of America + Stone 1999 Hawaii UP + McLaughlin 2019 Hawaii UP; Nichiren Gosho + Ikeda Human Revolution. Lane A batch required (could nest under Buddhism as corpus-split alternatively).

medium_priority_adds.label: Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn
medium_priority_adds.reason: Regardie 1937-40 (Llewellyn 1989) + Howe 1972 Routledge; Cipher Manuscripts + Regardie compendium are canonical. Vault has Regardie person node but no document node. Lane A batch required.

medium_priority_adds.label: Gurdjieff / Fourth Way
medium_priority_adds.reason: Webb 1980 Thames & Hudson + Moore 1991 Element + Hanegraaff 2006 Brill Dictionary; Beelzebub's Tales (1950) + Ouspensky In Search of the Miraculous (1949). Vault has Gurdjieff + Ouspensky person nodes but no document nodes. Lane A batch required.

medium_priority_adds.label: African Initiated Churches (parent wedge)
medium_priority_adds.reason: Sundkler 1948/1961 Oxford UP foundational; covers Shembe Izihlabelelo (Gunner 2004 Brill), Kimbangu revelations (MacGaffey 1983 Indiana UP + Martin 1975 Blackwell). EJCSK has ~10M adherents. Lane A batch required for 3 sub-corpus docs.

medium_priority_adds.label: Akan (Asante) Religion
medium_priority_adds.reason: Christaller 1879 proverb collection + Danquah 1944 Akan Doctrine of God + Gyekye 1987 Cambridge UP; tradition-akan.md + nyame.md exist but no 02_documents nodes. Lane A batch required.

result.coverage_assessment: After applying the three HIGH-PRIORITY structural fixes (Manichaeism rewire, Cathar/Bogomil wedge split, Lucumí/Santería corpus split) the 55-wedge / 100-corpus taxonomy becomes structurally sound — every existing vault doc routes to a canonically-correct corpus and wedge. Two major content gaps remain blocked on Lane A batches: Latin American syncretic traditions (Candomblé, Umbanda, Guadalupan/Nican Mopohua, Santa Muerte, Palo Mayombe, Kardecist Spiritism — 6 wedges, all Tier-1-sourced) and African Initiated Churches (Shembe, Kimbangu, Akan — 1 parent wedge + 3 corpora). After those land, the only remaining categories below scholarship-attention threshold are oral-substrate African religions (BaKongo, Igbo — ethnography-only, no indigenous scripture), school-specific sub-canons inside Tibetan/Japanese Buddhism + Jesuit/Franciscan Catholicism (blocked by zero vault docs in each), and thin Western esoteric branches (Martinism, Society of Inner Light) — all of which are correctly deferred until Lane A produces foundational documents to anchor them.
